messages:
Dana (Partnerships): Heads-up: Solara Health signed a 6-week AWS Marketplace Private Offer pilot to run Redwood Private in their VPC for clinical note summarization + PHI redaction. Co-sell with HealthCloud MSP. :tada:
Mateo (Sales): Awesome. Marketplace offer ID is PM-88244. Billing via Marketplace for pilot; we'll discuss Dedicated upsell later.
Priya (Legal): I'll send the DPA and Marketplace checklist. Need signed DPA before data access.
Noah (Eng): Tech notes: deploy into customer subnets, enable VPC endpoints and customer KMS, pin model version for perf. Can we get sample corpus for perf sizing?
Cara (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff set for Mon 11am PT. Solara asked for a short case study if pilot succeeds; wants weekly check-ins.
Mateo (Sales): Expansion targets: p95 latency <100ms, throughput 250 qps @256 seq, and redaction F1 > 0.90. Will coordinate exec intro.
Noah (Eng): Minimal infra snippet for infra team to review:
```
marketplace_offer: PM-88244
vpc:
  subnets: [subnet-01, subnet-02]
  endpoints: [s3, ec2]
models:
  - name: clinical-summarizer
    pin: v1.1.0
    seq_max: 256
kms:
  key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd
```
Dana (Partnerships): Ops ticket #PM-5738 created for onboarding artifacts and security checklist. MarketingBot reserved a case study slot. Shoutout to Mateo and Cara for moving fast. Reply here with blockers. :rocket:
